items.title: Amazon and University of Michigan give robots a sense of touch
items.summary: From warehouse automation to surgical assistance, many real-world applications depend on robots performing delicate, contact-intensive tasks. Often missing in these situations is the sense of touch: robots need to feel the forces on their fingertips to manipulate objects effectively. items.title: Muse Spark 1.1: Meta gains 8 Intelligence Index points in three months
items.summary: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and is cost and token efficient compared to its peers
items.summaryZh: Meta发布的Muse Spark 1.1在Artificial Analysis的智能指数中得分达到51分，较三个月前的1.0版本提升了8个点。该模型在科学推理、编码及代理知识工作方面表现突出，且在Token效率和运行成本上具有显著优势。评估显示，Muse Spark 1.1在处理复杂代理任务时，通过降低幻觉率和优化响应策略，实现了性能与成本的良好平衡。此外，该模型上下文窗口扩展至1M Token，进一步增强了其在长文本和复杂业务场景下的应用潜力，标志着Meta在模型前沿竞争中保持了强劲的追赶态势。
